name: news
description: Get top news headlines by country, search news articles by keyword, get breaking news, get news by category, or list available news sources.

action.description: top_headlines: top stories for a country. search: keyword search. breaking: current breaking news. by_category: news for one category. sources: list available news outlets.

country.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Used for top_headlines. Defaults to 'us'.

language.description: Language code for action='sources'. Defaults to 'en'.

limit.description: Max articles to return. Defaults to 10.
